entry.summary: Reported: Australian citizens are issued a 30-day entry permit on arrival, with a passport valid 6 months beyond the stay, an onward ticket and enough funds. American Samoa runs its own immigration, separate from the US; a US visa or ESTA doesn't cover it. Reports differ on whether the permit must be obtained before arrival.
entry.next_check: Ask the American Samoa Attorney General's Office (Immigration) whether Australians apply before arrival.

filming.detail: Filming in the National Park of American Samoa needs a National Park Service permit when it involves commercial equipment, sets, props or crews. culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Ask locally. Fa'a Samoa: dress modestly in villages. Ask permission before photographing people or using village beaches and customary land. Don't eat or walk around while others are seated. Sunday is for church and rest; move quietly through villages. Many villages keep an evening sa (prayer) curfew; stop and wait quietly until it ends.

laws.rule: Although a US territory, American Samoa sets its own entry laws, run by the Attorney General's Immigration Office. Visitors need a visitor permit applied for at least 72 hours ahead (excluding weekends and holidays); US visa-waiver travellers can apply online for a 30-day permit, which cannot be extended.
